headline: SUREBET DELIVERS AGAIN: 7.38 g/t AuEq OVER 35.7m — 19.51 g/t AuEq CORE; Golden Triangle System Open in All Directions After 52 of 98 Holes
snippet: Goliath Resources Ltd. (TSXV: GOT) released August 21, 2026 assay results from four drill holes at Surebet in BC's Golden Triangle, with hole GD-26-436 returning 7.38 g/t AuEq over 35.7 metres including a 19.51 g/t AuEq high-grade core over 8.32 metres. With 52 of 98 planned holes completed and visible gold in 33 of 52 holes, the fully funded 50,000-metre program continues to prove a high-grade system with consistent broad mineralization open laterally and at depth.

headline: BUNKER HILL BUYS SILVER47 FOR $163M ALL-STOCK — 'Made in America' US Silver Champion; Idaho Mine + Alaska-Nevada-NM Pipeline Combined
snippet: Bunker Hill Mining Corp. (TSX: BHLL) and Silver47 Exploration Corp. agreed August 21, 2026 to a plan of arrangement in which Bunker Hill acquires all Silver47 shares at 0.1724x, implying US$163 million equity value — the combined company to be renamed 'Bunker Hill Silver Corp.' and close in November. The deal pairs the cash-flowing Bunker Hill Mine in Idaho's Silver Valley with Silver47's exploration pipeline in Alaska, Nevada and New Mexico, creating a self-described 'Made in America' US silver and critical minerals champion with silver at $70 per ounce.

headline: ELEVRA LITHIUM LOCKS 7-YEAR TAKE-OR-PAY — 144,000 DMT/YR Spodumene With Floor Price to North American Converter; No Ocean Freight
snippet: Elevra Lithium Limited (ASX: ELV) executed a binding Spodumene Concentrate Supply Agreement August 21, 2026 with Mangrove Lithium for 122,000 dry metric tonnes in Year 1 and 144,000 dmt from Year 2, on a 7-year take-or-pay basis with a floor price above NAL's cost of production and no price ceiling. Deliveries go to Mangrove's proposed 20,000 t/yr LCE facility in Eastern Canada, eliminating ocean freight and locking in a domestic North American lithium supply chain as lithium carbonate has rebounded 84.56% year-over-year to CNY 152,250 per tonne.

headline: OSISKO METALS 312m AT 0.56% Cu AT GASPÉ — Largest Undeveloped Copper Resource in Eastern North America Expands; 35 Intercepts Advance MRE
snippet: Osisko Metals Inc. (TSX: OM) released August 20, 2026 results from 15 new drill holes at the Gaspé Copper Project in eastern Québec, returning 35 mineralized intercepts including 312 metres averaging 0.56% copper — both infill holes targeting MRE category upgrades and expansion intercepts extending mineralization outside the 2026 mineral resource model. Gaspé hosts the largest undeveloped copper resource in eastern North America; results continuing to add resource tonnes at grades comparable to the current model represent direct upside to project economics with LME copper above $14,000 per tonne.

headline: SILVER HITS $70 TODAY, +2.67% — Weaker Dollar and $40T Debt Trade Push White Metal to Two-Month High
snippet: Silver traded to $69.94 per ounce on August 21, 2026 — up 2.67% intraday — as the US Dollar Index fell below 99 and the $40 trillion US debt milestone continued driving safe-haven flows alongside gold, extending silver's weekly gain to approximately 5%. Industrial demand from AI infrastructure, automotive electronics and energy storage provides a structural bid beneath the financial flows, with silver now testing multi-year highs set earlier in August.

headline: LME COPPER SQUEEZE EASING — Premium Drops to $225/t From $545/t Peak as Traders Deliver Into Exchange; Structural Deficit Unchanged
snippet: The LME cash copper premium over three-month contracts fell to approximately $225 per tonne on August 21, 2026 — sharply down from the $545 per tonne extreme reached on August 17 — as traders responded to LME emergency intervention by delivering metal into warehouses, ending the 42-session consecutive drawdown. The rapid normalization validates the exchange's crisis measures but leaves the underlying structural supply imbalance intact: US tariff-driven inventory builds and Chinese demand continue compressing available inventories, keeping copper's medium-term fundamentals unchanged.

headline: GREENLAND TANBREEZ ON TRACK FOR 2029 RARE EARTH OUTPUT — CEO Says Non-Chinese Magnetic RE Supply Enters Western Market Inside 3 Years
snippet: Critical Metals Corp. (Nasdaq: CRML) CEO Tony Sage confirmed August 21, 2026 to Bloomberg that the Tanbreez rare earth project in southern Greenland remains on schedule to begin production in 2029, on time to serve the procurement window identified by the July 2026 US Executive Order restructuring DoD critical mineral sourcing away from China. Tanbreez hosts one of the world's largest rare earth deposits; a 2029 first production timeline makes it among the first non-Asian projects capable of supplying meaningful critical rare earth volumes to Western defence and industrial customers inside this decade.

headline: SILVER 'BARELY OWNED' AT 20TH PERCENTILE — Spec Positioning Washed Out Before $70 Push; Sixth Year of Supply Deficit at 46.3 Moz
snippet: GoldSilver.com's August 2026 monthly silver outlook documented speculative positioning in silver at the 20th percentile of the past 60 weeks — more underowned than in four-fifths of recent sessions — even as the market entered its sixth consecutive year of supply deficit with a projected 46.3 million ounce structural shortfall. The analysis argues a rally from this positioning baseline, where institutional and managed-money flows have largely stepped away, is driven by genuine physical demand and real-money buying rather than speculative excess, making the recent move to $70 structurally more durable than a crowded-position spike.
